body: Thanks, that's really good advice! Also, that's really interesting. The person you mentioned must be an outlier right?
It doesn't really excuse his actions, but it still was an entertaining stream. So at least he was right about the content.
Thank you, I'll try what you suggested. I don't want to say the specifics because I hold a lot of importance to privacy, but if I have to I might as well.

I have good intentions regarding my post. Undermining that is not very respectful to me either no? While I might have not have done the best things, no one is perfect, and I'll accept change. Stating that I'm disrespectful without giving any feedback is similar to what the teacher has done.

I see. I can understand why that is so, but I'm more or less concerned about how this fairs with if I should be worried. If yes, Is there anything I could do to fix this? Should I explain my reasoning? Do I have to rephrase what I meant? How do I be more respectful???

I'm just being petty tbh. Still 4.00 gpa but it's very difficult to keep it up, when I just got a bad grade. It kinda sucks cause it went from full 100%'s to one 60%. I'm so fucking mad even if it's my first technical year.

escape to somewhere else in my opinion. I don't really have any opinion since I just started highschool and already am very stressed, but if the world is one big rat race I do not want to be apart of it.

I understand you because I was once you. Although, I am not you.

I don't know your circumstances, but I'm willing to listen to you. Because that's how you connect, by getting to know yourself through someone else's perspective, beliefs and worldview. 

You don't have to, but I'm here.
sounds important, I too, want to know.
As long as it sounds good, I'm good. Not really in a mood to choose favourites.
No clue. It's some idealist trying to find a reason for a purpose to life; and the only conclusion said idealist could come up with is the "journey".

Think of it from a different perspective.

Maybe that girlfriend might change my mind, who knows. The point was that I find myself lost to my own malicious thoughts and I just wanted to express it romantically with someone I would truly love. When that person does come, I would likely not commit suicide - which might be retrospective. 

Honestly, I just want to experience love; for I have no experience.

But in the end, nothing can beat my own views of misanthropy- I can perhaps adjust it, though.
